children: BAE Systems received $16M in Defense Production Act Title III funding to demonstrate and qualify its radiation-hardened 45nm RH45 technology and reestablish the RH45 ASIC Storefront with GlobalFoundries’ 45nm SOI manufacturing.
Direct U.S. backing supports BAE’s rad‑hard chip platform; can de-risk costs and accelerate adoption.
Qualification is a gate to flight programs; enables revenue from space and defense payloads.
Restores customer access to custom rad‑hard ASICs, expanding addressable programs.
Secures U.S. supply chain via GlobalFoundries Malta, lowering supply risk.
Productization into SBCs can speed design wins with agencies and primes.

This is an early-to-mid step reinforcing BAE’s U.S. rad‑hard electronics position and supply security. A larger catalyst would be design wins or production awards for RH45-based SBCs or ASICs on named space or defense programs.
